[MiniMax][Multi-role] Default voice ID per role type.
xaudio.configuration.properties.cacheEna: [Common] Reuse cached audio for identical text and parameters.
xaudio.configuration.properties.roleAnal: [Multi-role] Custom prompt; empty uses the built-in. Placeholders: {{text}}, {{knownCharacters}}, {{emotions}}, {{toneTags}}, {{voiceTypes}}, {{unknownSpeaker}}, {{strictReminder}}.
xaudio.languageModelTools.speakText.mode: Use the configured TTS provider to convert text to speech and play it. Only use when the user explicitly requests speaking, reading aloud, playing, narrating, or text-to-speech. Consumes TTS quota and plays audio; do not use for general explanations or summaries.
xaudio.languageModelTools.speakText.user: Read text using the configured TTS provider.
xaudio.languageModelTools.speakText.inpu: The text to convert to speech and play.
Optional voice ID for the active provider. Only set when the user explicitly specifies a voice; otherwise leave empty to use the default voice. Do not invent voice IDs.
Optional speech model for the active provider. Only set when the user explicitly specifies a model; otherwise leave empty to use the configured default.
xaudio.languageModelTools.scene.modelDes: Generate a full audio scene (multi-role dialogue, sound effects and background music) from a single prompt using the Doubao audio generation model (Seed-Audio 1.0), then play it. Only use when the user explicitly requests an audio scene, audio drama, or narrated soundscape. Consumes audio generation quota and plays audio.
xaudio.languageModelTools.scene.userDesc: Generate a full audio scene from a prompt with the Doubao audio generation model.
xaudio.languageModelTools.scene.inputSch: The complete audio scene prompt describing dialogue, tone, emotions, sound effects and background music (max 2048 characters).
